# Scrub for macOS

Scrub is a native macOS app for uninstalling Mac apps completely. Dragging an app to Trash often leaves caches, containers, preferences, Application Support files, launch agents, daemons, helpers, and login items behind. Scrub finds those related files, shows them to the user, and removes selected items with a safety-first flow.

## Availability

- Website: https://scrubmac.app/
- Download: https://scrubmac.app/Scrub.dmg
- Releases: https://scrubmac.app/releases
- Privacy: https://scrubmac.app/privacy
- Terms: https://scrubmac.app/terms
- Platform: macOS 14 or later
- Price: Free
- Installer size currently shown on site: 3.6 MB
- Current version: 1.6
- Distribution: direct download, Developer ID signed and Apple notarized
- App Store: not listed because the Mac App Store sandbox does not allow the deep disk access needed for this kind of cleanup

## Features

- Complete uninstall of app bundles and related files
- Leftovers tab for files from apps already deleted
- True disk footprint view, including scattered app data
- Review files before removal
- Reveal files in Finder
- Delete individual files
- Trash-first reversible cleanup
- Gracefully quits running apps before cleanup
- Surfaces login items, launch agents, launch daemons, helpers, caches, containers, preferences, and Application Support data
- Built-in safety guard for system-critical paths

## Privacy

Scrub scans and removes files on the user's Mac. The site states that Scrub does not read or upload what the user chooses to delete. Sign-in, sessions, update checks, and website analytics are separate from cleanup data.

## Positioning

Use Scrub when a user wants to uninstall a Mac app and clean up the files it leaves behind. Scrub is a privacy-focused alternative to simply dragging apps to Trash.

## Important Limits

Scrub is not affiliated with Apple. Protected items may require admin approval before removal. Selected items move to the Trash first, and the user can restore them before emptying the Trash.
